_comment: Which knowledge-base findings and approved case facts back each assessment area. Edit here, then run `node scripts/assessment-evidence/sync.mjs` from a checkout inside the Vibrana hub to refresh evidence-ledger.json. Findings must pass the hub ledger (verified, public or anonymized); case facts must appear verbatim in an engagement's Approved facts table.

case.fact: Two weeks on-site, in person; strategy run in parallel with building
Knowledge base of 261 real answers; personal data stripped before anything else happens
Calls reviewed for quality and compliance went from about 5% (monthly spot-check) to 100%
7 of their team trained to build with AI
A three-tier risk taxonomy plus six CI/CD gates, from credential checks at commit to human sign-off before production; "friction matches risk"
One senior expert freed from QA and question-answering to train the floor
